mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.username AS author_name FROM forum_replies r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.topic_id = #{topicId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT r.*, u.username AS author_name FROM forum_replies r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_replies WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_replies (topic_id, user_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{topicId}, #{userId}, #{content}, 1, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_replies SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
